name: @memstack/core
description: Open-source AI memory framework — store, retrieve, summarize, and prune memories for LLM agents and games

scripts.check:packages: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @memstack/config-env build && pnpm --filter @memstack/config-env check && pnpm --filter @memstack/cli check && pnpm --filter @memstack/mcp check && pnpm --filter @memstack/server check
scripts.test:packages: pnpm build:all && pnpm --filter @memstack/config-env test && pnpm --filter @memstack/cli test && pnpm --filter @memstack/mcp test && pnpm --filter @memstack/server test
scripts.verify: pnpm check:all && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:packages && pnpm build:all && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm smoke:artifacts && pnpm smoke:packages && pnpm smoke:docker
scripts.prepublishOnly: npx tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run
